description.translate: Bring twelve copper ingots for the worn instrument fittings. We can restore the tools of study without pretending we can recreate the blade from a few surviving sketches. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

The Inferno was the next power he wanted to capture. Earlier successes had made him overconfident. He carried the sword into battle before completing its greater awakening or the preparations his companions urged him to finish. He never completed that experiment.
